title: Unrequited Emotions: Investigating the Gaps in Motivation and Practice in Speech Emotion Recognition Research
reasoning: This paper is a systematic survey and critical analysis of the Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) field. Its primary objective is to evaluate the alignment between researchers' stated motivations and their actual research practices as a matter of research ethics and task validity. Because the entire study is an ethical audit and evaluation of the field's values and practices, it goes far beyond a standard 'Ethical Considerations' section.
